rationale: Alex and Anders both work at the intersection of developer tools and AI infrastructure, with overlapping conviction that fragmentation is a real problem in this space. Anders is shipping AI-native automation tools (Magnitude, Sagekit) and has fractional CTO experience advising early-stage teams on product and technical execution—exactly the kind of hands-on expertise that could inform Alex's perspective on ML dev tooling unification.
intro_message: Alex Kreidler, meet Anders Lie — you both see developer tools and AI infrastructure as fragmented ecosystems worth solving, and Anders has built multiple YC companies and run a fractional CTO practice bringing AI-native tooling to market, which could be a useful perspective exchange.
